record.bible_text: <FI> Set<Fi> the trumpet<WH07782> to thy mouth<WH02441>. <FI>He shall come<Fi> as an eagle<WH05404> against the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068>, because they have transgressed<WH05674><WTH8804> my covenant<WH01285>, and trespassed<WH06586><WTH8804> against my law<WH08451>. <RF>thy: Heb. the roof of thy<Rf>
Israel<WH03478> shall cry<WH02199><WTH8799> unto me, My God<WH0430>, we know<WH03045><WTH8804> thee.
Israel<WH03478> hath cast off<WH02186><WTH8804> <FI>the thing that is<Fi> good<WH02896>: the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> shall pursue<WH07291><WTH8799> him.

They have set up kings<WH04427><WTH8689>, but not by me: they have made princes<WH07786><WTH8689>, and I knew<WH03045><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> not: of their silver<WH03701> and their gold<WH02091> have they made<WH06213><WTH8804> them idols<WH06091>, that they may be cut off<WH03772><WTH8735>.

Thy calf<WH05695>, O Samaria<WH08111>, hath cast<WH02186><WTH8804> <FI>thee<Fi> off; mine anger<WH0639> is kindled<WH02734><WTH8804> against them: how long <FI>will it be<Fi> ere<WH03808> they attain<WH03201><WTH8799> to innocency<WH05356>?

For from Israel<WH03478> <FI>was<Fi> it also: the workman<WH02796> made<WH06213><WTH8804> it; therefore it <FI>is<Fi> not God<WH0430>: but the calf<WH05695> of Samaria<WH08111> shall be broken in pieces<WH07616>.

For they have sown<WH02232><WTH8799> the wind<WH07307>, and they shall reap<WH07114><WTH8799> the whirlwind<WH05492>: it hath no stalk<WH07054>: the bud<WH06780> shall yield<WH06213><WTH8799> no meal<WH07058>: if<WH0194> so be it yield<WH06213><WTH8799>, the strangers<WH02114><WTH8801> shall swallow it up<WH01104><WTH8799>. <RF>stalk: or, standing corn<Rf><CM>
Israel<WH03478> is swallowed up<WH01104><WTH8738>: now shall they be among the Gentiles<WH01471> as a vessel<WH03627> wherein <FI>is<Fi> no pleasure<WH02656>.

For they are gone up<WH05927><WTH8804> to Assyria<WH0804>, a wild ass<WH06501> alone<WH0909><WTH8802> by himself: Ephraim<WH0669> hath hired<WH08566><WTH8689> lovers<WH0158>. <RF>lovers: Heb. loves<Rf>

Yea, though they have hired<WH08566><WTH8799> among the nations<WH01471>, now will I gather<WH06908><WTH8762> them, and they shall sorrow<WH02490><WTH8686> a little<WH04592> for the burden<WH04853> of the king<WH04428> of princes<WH08269>. <RF>sorrow: or, begin<Rf> <RF>a...: or, in a little while<Rf>
Because Ephraim<WH0669> hath made many<WH07235><WTH8689> altars<WH04196> to sin<WH02398><WTH8800>, altars<WH04196> shall be unto him to sin<WH02398><WTH8800>.
I have written<WH03789><WTH8799> to him the great things<WH07230><WTH8675><WH07239> of my law<WH08451>, <FI>but<Fi> they were counted<WH02803><WTH8738> as a strange thing<WH02114><WTH8801>.

They sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8799> flesh<WH01320> <FI>for<Fi> the sacrifices<WH02077> of mine offerings<WH01890>, and eat<WH0398><WTH8799> <FI>it; but<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> accepteth<WH07521><WTH8804> them not; now will he remember<WH02142><WTH8799> their iniquity<WH05771>, and visit<WH06485><WTH8799> their sins<WH02403>: they shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> to Egypt<WH04714>. <RF>They sacrifice...: or, In the sacrifices of mine offerings they, etc<Rf>

For Israel<WH03478> hath forgotten<WH07911><WTH8799> his Maker<WH06213><WTH8802>, and buildeth<WH01129><WTH8799> temples<WH01964>; and Judah<WH03063> hath multiplied<WH07235><WTH8689> fenced<WH01219><WTH8803> cities<WH05892>: but I will send<WH07971><WTH8765> a fire<WH0784> upon his cities<WH05892>, and it shall devour<WH0398><WTH8804> the palaces<WH0759> thereof.<CM>
